seo.title: Shiprocket order tracking on WhatsApp and chat | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Shiprocket to Steps AI so customers can track orders on WhatsApp, Instagram and your website, and delivery problems reach your team.

hero.title: Let customers track Shiprocket deliveries in the chat.
hero.body: Customers ask where their order is. Your agent checks the shipment in Shiprocket and replies with the latest status, on whichever channel they used.
hero.reassurance: Live shipment status. Every channel. Your team steps in when something goes wrong.

lines.text: It is with Shiprocket and out for delivery today.

useCases.title: What you can do with Shiprocket connected.
useCases.intro: Fewer "where is my order" messages for your team, and faster answers for customers.

items.title: Answer delivery questions instantly
items.body: The agent checks the shipment in Shiprocket and replies with the latest status, any time of day.

items.title: Answer in the same chat
items.body: Customers get the delivery update where they asked, so they do not have to search their email or call you.

items.title: Use the same answers on every channel
items.body: Tracking works the same way on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website.

items.title: Hand delivery problems to your team
items.body: If a parcel is delayed or damaged, the agent can raise a ticket or pass the conversation to a person with the order details.

items.title: Cover every courier you ship with
items.body: Shipments booked through Shiprocket can be tracked from one connection, whichever courier carries the parcel.

walkthrough.title: A delivery question, answered in the chat.
walkthrough.intro: What happens when a customer messages about a parcel.

steps.label: Customer asks about a delivery
steps.customer: Hi, my order has not arrived yet.
steps.agent: Sorry about the wait. Can you share your order number?
steps.note: The agent asks only for what it needs to find the shipment.

steps.label: Check the shipment in Shiprocket
steps.agent: Your parcel is with Shiprocket and out for delivery today.
steps.note: The status comes from Shiprocket, not from a guess.

steps.label: Handle a problem
steps.customer: The tracking has not moved in four days.
steps.agent: I have raised this with our team and they will get back to you today.
steps.note: Delivery issues become a ticket or a handoff, with the order details attached.

setup.title: Connect Shiprocket in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Shiprocket
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Shiprocket. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Shiprocket to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Match orders to shipments
items.body: Connect your store as well, so the agent can find the order first and then the shipment that belongs to it.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The agent shares the status that Shiprocket reports. It cannot change a delivery date or reroute a parcel.
Customers need an order number or the details your agent asks for, so it shares tracking only with the right person.

items.q: Do I need a store connected as well as Shiprocket?
items.a: Connecting Shopify or WooCommerce lets the agent match an order to its shipment. Ask us about your setup if you use a different store.
Steps AI connects with Shiprocket, Delhivery, DTDC, iThink Logistics and WareIQ.

items.q: What happens when the parcel has a problem?
items.a: The agent can create a ticket or hand the conversation to your team, so a person follows it up.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with Shiprocket.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using Shiprocket and your own information.
